title: Tumble & Pip, Episode 2: Big and Small!
prompt: A 45-second vertical (9:16) cartoon episode for children aged 3 to 5. Tumble the clay fox cub and his tiny bird friend Pip go on a picnic in a sunny meadow and play "big and small". Tumble sings every BIG thing in a deep, slow voice; Pip sings every tiny thing in a high, quick voice. Four rounds, each with a slapstick gag: a big apple rolls away with Pip running on top; Tumble's big leaf fan blows Pip head over tail into the picnic basket; Tumble sits on a tiny mushroom and it squashes and boings him into the air; Pip's tiny stomp goes "tap" while Tumble's big hop shakes the whole meadow. Bouncy 6/8 jig with tuba and tin whistle. The word BIG appears huge on screen and the word "tiny" appears tiny. Finale in split screen, BIG on top and small below, then a crane up over the meadow as they wave goodbye.
voice: ElevenLabs Music v2.5 duet (deep BIG voice + high tiny voice) + ElevenLabs TTS Liam (Tumble) / Jessica (Pip)
